short_term_14d.synthesis: S: The short-term outlook remains bullish, with a STRONG_BULLISH candle pattern. T: The score has slightly increased due to improved velocity and continued price stability near the SMA20. Conviction remains stable as RSI has moved to neutral. Risk has marginally increased due to the price testing new resistance levels and the ongoing regulatory concerns highlighted in the news.

The hyper-premium valuation multiples (P/E: 37.65, P/S: 20.17) and elevated implied growth (PEG: 2.66) continue to represent a structural risk. Long-term news flow continues to highlight regulatory scrutiny, but the price action suggests the market is currently discounting these risks. T: The score and conviction have increased due to the price breaking out to new all-time highs and the continued strength of the secular bull market regime. Risk has marginally increased due to the extreme valuation and the 'blue sky' nature of the current price action, which can be prone to sharp reversals.
